patterns: One raised sheet per screen; lists sit on the ground with hairlines
Italian in Newsreader with lang="it"; English help in Figtree
Primary action pinned to the bottom of Home

must: WCAG 2.2 AA contrast and full keyboard operation
A calm alternative for every animation under prefers-reduced-motion
Every number comes from real speech or real reviews
avoid: Kids' game chrome: XP, gems, hearts, confetti
Generic AI chatbot patterns: chat bubbles, sparkles, the word AI
Corporate e-learning dashboards and progress bars for everything
Dark mode by default, neon, glowing gradients

decisions.rationale: Inverted the hierarchy: the notebook of review items, Giulia's memory and past calls is the page; the citofono became a sticky brass call bar so the call stays the primary action. Merged /history into the main screen.
rejected: La Chiamata (full-bleed call screen) - dead between calls, history hidden behind a gesture
Il Citofono refined - smallest diff but the app stays dead between calls
decisions.notes: 21st catalogue search returned only assistant chrome (sidebars, agent docks, voice-input pills); nothing adopted, since the product's premise is a person rather than an assistant.

decisions.chosen: Primitives in components/ui.tsx, an app header with a real stat strip, loading and error segments, and a living style guide at /stile
decisions.rationale: The page read as a document because every screen was one-off markup with no shell, no loading state and no error state. Extracted a component vocabulary, added a stat strip built only from real data, and made /stile import the same module so the guide cannot drift.
decisions.notes: 21st catalogue searched twice; results were assistant chrome and colour-picker widgets, so nothing was installed. 21st review took the change from 14 findings to 0 by promoting the paper/brass colours and the slip shadow to tokens.

decisions.area: Home, call, review and listening design pass
decisions.rationale: Home had grown to 4,150px with the call button only in the first card. Today's call became a ticket (mission above a perforated tear, Rome's time on split flaps, three phrases below) after Flighty and airport boards; the phrases come from Babbel Speak's key-phrases-before-speaking scaffold and turn green in the call once said. Call Giulia is pinned to the bottom of Home, the 17 due notes fold into a disclosure, review puts rating buttons under the thumb and keeps a wrong sentence readable with a wavy tomato underline.
rejected: Quiet notebook - same flow fixes with no new identity
Giulia full screen (after Duolingo's Video Call with Lily) - strongest character but the largest change, and Home would compete with the call screen
decisions.notes: 21st search returned HTTP 401 (saved login expired), so research came from Duolingo, Babbel Speak, Flighty and Citymapper instead.
